description: This file defines the ModuleScreen class, which is a Data Transfer Object (DTO) used within the OrangeHRM Core plugin to encapsulate information about a module and its associated screen within the HR system. It provides getters and setters for module and screen properties, including overridden versions.

classes.name: ModuleScreen
classes.description: A Data Transfer Object that represents a module and screen within the OrangeHRM system, including overridden module and screen data.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor initializing module and screen properties, also synchronizes overridden properties.

methods.name: setModule
methods.description: Sets the module name and updates overridden module if needed.

methods.name: setScreen
methods.description: Sets the screen name and updates overridden screen if needed.
